description.value: Gneiss Wines is a small-lot artisan winery housed in the District Wine Village in Oliver, BC, a curated cluster of South Okanagan wine, beer, and spirits producers a few minutes from downtown. The name references the gneiss rock formations underlying their Naramata Bench vineyard, which runs along more than a kilometre of the Kettle Valley Railway cycling trail. Founded by partners with multi-generational Okanagan roots, the winery crafts small-batch varietals including Tempranillo, Cabernet Franc, Pinot Gris, and Pinot Noir from sustainably managed local vineyards.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: Website confirms an active winery tasting room and retail shop at #106-100 Enterprise Way, Oliver, BC (District Wine Village), with phone 250-485-4932 — both sourced from the website since OSM fields are blank. No cyclist-specific amenities (bike parking, water refill, washrooms, Wi-Fi) are mentioned anywhere on the site. Notably, the Naramata Bench vineyard page states 'over a KM of frontage on the KVR trail,' flagging this as highly relevant to cyclists touring that iconic rail-trail corridor.
concerns: OSM record contains no phone or address; both values sourced entirely from the website.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, open, publicly accessible winery tasting room and bottle shop in Oliver, BC; directly relevant to cyclists touring the South Okanagan wine region and the KVR trail corridor.
enrichment_extras.notes: The Naramata Bench vineyard description explicitly mentions over 1 km of KVR trail frontage — worth highlighting in any cyclist-facing copy even though the tasting room itself is in Oliver.
